as_told.title: Hawkeye 360 patent as how aliens could track implant beacons

plain: A former CIA contractor named Bob McGwier says he wrote a patent that shows how aliens could track people through implants, the small devices that abduction stories say are placed in people's bodies. He tells Michels that he "didn't believe these stories at all about these implants" being used for tracking until he wrote the patent "that tells you how they do it". He says it is a patent for a company he calls Hawkeye 360, and that its method "is how the aliens would find these beacons all over the planet". If he is right, abductees' implants could work like radio tags that can be located from anywhere. The patent itself is not quoted, and McGwier says nothing about what is in it beyond this. Both tellings are his, in the same conversation, and no one else adds to the account.
